messages:
sam: Quick flag 10% of fncall traces show tool_call=null and validator=null. Console shows fallback but no reject telemetry.
zara: paste a sample?
sam: anonymized: `{"req":"r-901","model":"open-7b","resp":{"text":"...","tool_call":null},"validator":null}`
frank: thats the silent soft-reject we intentionally nulled to avoid billing noise. Problem is we lose observability and routing attribution.
zara: propose emitting a tiny validator envelope for soft rejects: `{status: "soft_reject", code: "enum_mismatch", billing_exempt: true}` — keeps billing but surfaces reason.
sam: also need metric `fncall.validation.soft_reject_total{env,route,model}` and audit log `AUDIT fncall soft_reject r-901 reason=enum_mismatch` so logs can be parsed.
ui-team: Console: add collapsed per-route "soft rejects" badge + timeline, link to request id. Behind FF.
frank: router change: treat `validator.status=="soft_reject"` as route_tag=soft_reject so quotas/SLAs aren't misattributed to degen. Backwards compatible if validator missing.
sam: i'll add tests for router + metric emission. frank will land proxy envelope change. zara will coordinate console + docs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy started (id s-777) for proxy patch by frank.
sam: will run canary after staging green. update here with spikes or churn observed. :thumbsup:
